en.headline: Police smash three drug stores in Kwai Chung and Tsuen Wan, arrest four including three…
en.dek: Officers seized ketamine, crack cocaine and other drugs worth more than HK$1.4 million; a 19-year-old is alleged to have recruited the three minors for storage, packaging and delivery work during the summer holiday.
body: Police raided three suspected drug storage locations in Kwai Chung and Tsuen Wan on Tuesday evening and arrested four local men aged 16 to 19, three of them minors, on suspicion of trafficking and conspiracy to traffic in dangerous drugs.

The Narcotics Bureau’s action group said the operation targeted a syndicate that recruited young people with offers of quick money during the summer holiday. Officers recovered more than 1.4 kilograms of suspected ketamine, more than 700 grams of suspected crack cocaine and about 150 grams of another suspected drug, with a total estimated street value exceeding HK$1.4 million.

A 19-year-old man who claimed to work as a removal worker is alleged to have managed the stores and directed the three youths, aged 16 and 17, in packaging and delivery. Police said the minors had been introduced by friends and were each paid a few hundred dollars. One of them is a student.

The four men will be charged and are due to appear at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. Police reiterated that drug trafficking is not a short-cut to easy money and carries severe penalties.

zh.headline: 警搗葵涌荃灣三毒品倉拘4人 包括3名未成年少年
zh.dek: 檢獲氯胺酮、霹靂可卡因等市值逾140萬元毒品；19歲男子疑招攬3名16至17歲少年管倉、包裝及派送，每人報酬數百元，案件明日西九龍法院提堂。
body: 警方毒品調查科聯同新界南總區刑事部於周二晚上突擊搜查葵涌及荃灣三個毒品儲存倉，拘捕4名年齡介乎16至19歲的本地男子，當中3人未成年，涉嫌販運及串謀販運危險藥物。
行動中檢獲超過1.4公斤懷疑氯胺酮、超過700克懷疑霹靂可卡因及約150克其他懷疑毒品，市值超過140萬元。警方指行動針對暑假期間以「搵快錢」利誘青少年參與販毒的集團。
19歲報稱搬運工人的男子疑擔任管理角色，招攬及指示其餘3名16至17歲少年負責管倉、包裝及派送。據了解，少年經朋友介紹，每人報酬約500至700元，其中一人為學生。
4人將被暫控相關罪名，明日於西九龍裁判法院提堂。警方提醒年輕人，販毒並非賺快錢捷徑，而是要付出沉重代價的不歸路。
